notes: DiscoFlate v3.37.0 — 'Tracked users' is now 'Leaderboards': a 'Broadcast Top Pumpers:' line with Current + Lifetime buttons, each with a 🗑 that confirms before resetting that board (Current = this session's pumpers & tracked list; Lifetime = the all-time board). New conditional message lines: start a line with [if name] and it shows only when that placeholder has a value (e.g. [if runnerup]🥈 Runner-up: [runnerup]); [if not name] for the inverse; works with any placeholder. Awards to a placeholder with no value (e.g. [runnerup] when there wasn't one) quietly skip.
